title: 简化自然语言中任意条件建模
summary: 提出AC-GPT，通过对标准因果Transformer进行简单修改，实现在单次前向传播中评估和采样任意条件（包括过去、未来和混合上下文），无需牺牲标准从左到右的性能，并支持现有LLM微调。
summary_en: Proposes AC-GPT, a simple modification to standard causal Transformers that enables evaluating and sampling from arbitrary conditionals (past, future, mixed contexts) in a single forward pass without degrading standard left-to-right performance, and supports fine-tuning existing LLMs.
